title: Delivery explanation, contract version 1
description: The body of an answer of the delivery API's GET /v1/resolve with debug=1 (PRD 8.9, GUARDRAILS 5), which only an actor whose classification access is at least internal gets: the answer the request would have had, a record with its meta, a problem, or neither for a redirect (301, whose URL the explanation's redirect step names), with its HTTP status and the explanation of the resolution. It is never stored or shared. Every key is always present, and a value that does not apply is null. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Delivery\Domain\Dto\DeliveryExplanation, and the generated codec DeliveryExplanationCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

data.description: The record, as data of delivery.v1.json holds it, or null when the answer is a problem or a redirect.

explanation.description: The explanation of the resolution, a document of path-explanation.v1.json, read as the caller's principal.

meta.description: What the record is, as meta of delivery.v1.json holds it, or null when the answer is a problem or a redirect.

problem.description: The problem, a document of problem.v1.json, or null when the answer is a record or a redirect.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.

meta.description: What the record is: its type, the locale requested and the locale its variant is in, whether and which fields fell back along the site's fallback chain (PRD 10.3), the canonical URL and the version of the record contract.

canonical_url.description: The canonical URL of the entry in the locale (PRD 5.7), or null when the reader can read no canonical placement with a URL.

contract.description: The version of the record contract the record is written in (RecordCodecs::VERSION), 1.

fallback.description: Whether the record is the variant of another locale than the one requested, the first locale after it in the site's fallback chain whose variant is released (PRD 10.3); false for a type without localization.

fallback_fields.description: The fields marked fallback: field that the record's variant leaves empty and that took their value from a later locale of the site's fallback chain, by their address, such as teaser or ext.reviews.summary, sorted; empty for a type without localization.

locale.description: The locale requested, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS.

resolved_locale.description: The locale of the record's variant, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS: the locale requested, or with fallback the locale it fell back to; the locale requested for a type without localization.

type.description: The name of the record's type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post; the record is in that type's record contract.
